checks.title: IDNrG official law, last amended 19 July 2024
checks.check_result: General commencement 31 August 2023. Section 2 no. 1 ends at the fifth following calendar year, hence 31 December 2028. Base-data maintenance and ex-officio correction preserve special rules. Section 6 permits both identifier and demographic matching; unsuccessful unique matching returns no data. Section 10 allocates correction, notification and cooperation duties.
checks.limits: The common identifier is not the only conceivable object/person matching mechanism; a discrepancy alone does not prove which dataset is false.
